text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I guess we're almost done with this job, aren't we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうすぐ
このお仕事も終わりだね……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Stay alert.
There's no telling what can happen before it's all over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最後まで何があるか分からないよ。
注意して。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Roger that!
We're almost at the finish line.
Let's clean house and start the new year off feeling great!
text_block_list.orig_text:
了解っ！　
ラストスパートいっくよー！
みんなで一緒に
ハッピーなお正月を迎えようねっ！
